Official source and revision: Record the exact title, decision number, date and latest Senate Monitor check.
Operational value to record: Record whether a later amendment, replacement or correction exists.
Status and retained evidence: CONFIRMED only after dated check; retain the regulation and monitor evidence.

Official source and revision: Record faculty, programme, bachelor’s or master’s route, cohort status and session.
Operational value to record: Record any conditional mobility, previous-cohort, additional-year or external-institution route.
Status and retained evidence: Retain the status evidence and the source that activates any condition.

Official source and revision: Record approved title, supervisor, request route, approval date and deadline source.
Operational value to record: Record the approval or the unresolved action required.
Status and retained evidence: Retain the approved request and authoritative title string.

Official source and revision: Record the applicable regulatory minimum and the current-session operational deadline.
Operational value to record: Record justification, endorsements, approval and effect on the title record.
Status and retained evidence: Use NOT APPLICABLE or retain the complete written approval chain.

Official source and revision: Record exact title, final PDF name, hash and applicable declaration version.
Operational value to record: Record placement of the declaration in the work and the distinct signed copy required for registration.
Status and retained evidence: Retain the frozen PDF, hash log and signed declaration copy.

Official source and revision: Record opening and closing date, time, time zone where relevant, platform and eligible account.
Operational value to record: Record upload receipt, file hash, report identifier and supervisor-review deadline.
Status and retained evidence: PENDING until the official window is released; retain receipt and report when CLOSED.

Official source and revision: Record decision vocabulary, decision date and controlling source.
Operational value to record: Record corrections required before admission or the final admission decision.
Status and retained evidence: Retain the dated decision and the analysed report.

Official source and revision: Record official recipient or channel, deadline and required file identity.
Operational value to record: Record transmission date, receipt and hash match against the reviewed file.
Status and retained evidence: CONFLICT if sources disagree on channel or deadline; do not guess.

Official source and revision: Record opening and closing date, exact final-day cut-off, channel and complete dossier list.
Operational value to record: Record conditional documents, approvals or fees without treating them as universal.
Status and retained evidence: Retain dossier inventory, submission evidence and any written clarification.

Official source and revision: Record who confirms registration, by what channel and by when.
Operational value to record: Record confirmation identifier, message or status and any defect requiring correction.
Status and retained evidence: Not CLOSED until confirmation or equivalent official evidence is retained.

Official source and revision: Record commission, individual slot, place or mode and, for bachelor’s candidates, the current topics and bibliography.
Operational value to record: Record the publication source, revision date and last pre-attendance check.
Status and retained evidence: CONFLICT if two current sources disagree; retain the authoritative resolution.

Official source and revision: Record official date, time, place or mode, structure and any route-specific presentation rule.
Operational value to record: Record accessibility arrangements or other approved conditions where applicable.
Status and retained evidence: Use only the current competent source; never infer missing values from another route.

Official source and revision: Record publication channel, result date and applicable final evidence.
Operational value to record: Record final submitted file, receipts, approvals, result record and resolved authority log.
Status and retained evidence: Mark CLOSED only when the retained set supports the complete route.
